moach.title: Events
moach.intro: A webinar, workshop or open house of the rikma: a landing page, dates, registration and reminders. Everyone who registers also lands in the rikma's leads.
moach.unavailable: Events are not available on this server yet.
moach.emptyBody: An event is a good way to meet new people: explain what the rikma does, and whoever is interested registers.

editor.title: Title
editor.slugHint: Latin letters, digits and hyphens. Empty = chosen for you
editor.taglineHint: One sentence on why it's worth coming
editor.sessionsHint: Several dates raise sign-ups. Times follow your computer's clock.
editor.roomMeetingsHint: The room opens when the date is saved. Each registrant gets a personal way in, no account needed.
editor.linkHint: Not shown on the page. Registrants get it only while the event is on
editor.formHint: Name, email and phone are always on the form. You can add up to 5 questions — every question costs sign-ups, so only what you really need.
